page.overview:
Who is Fumi Joestar?

He is a teenager living in Morioh in 1941, who agrees to help Lucy Steel when she arrives to investigate the Locacaca. He is the grandson of Johnny Joestar and Rina Higashikata, and has an unnamed Stand that creates vines, similar to the original Joseph Joestar.

Joseph is a 17-year old male of average height. He sports a collared shirt underneath a long-sleeved sweater. The sweater's left breast is adorned with an emblem of a horse's head inside a horseshoe on a crest, and the neckline of the sweater is bordered by a checkered pattern. His shorts are dark in color, knee-length, and baggy. The belt of his shorts holds up a small rectangular pouch on each hip. Joseph goes sockless, with geta (wooden sandals). In the cover page art for Chapter 109, he is seen with a book bag over one shoulder. The shoulder strap is connected to the bag itself with the same emblem of the sweater, as well as a circular shape with a star in the center just above the emblem, on either side of the bag. In the middle of the front flap of the bag, is an ornament resembling the face of Josuke's Stand, Soft & Wet.

Joseph's hair is light in color, and buzzcut - save for two opposite pointing horizontal strands of hair just below three spheres above his hairline. His facial features are very soft - round, dark-coloured eyes and a small nose. The star-shaped birthmark of the Joestar family line is on his left shoulder (and is seemingly where his Stand manifests from).

Joseph is quick to respond to a situation, and he is very willing to help those in need. He cares much for his girlfriend; to the extent that when he realizes a thief stole his wallet he takes up Lucy's job offer in order to get some quick cash to pay for his date. He is informative of local news/rumors, as seen when he explains the 'Radio Gaga Incident' to Lucy after showing concern for her wanting to visit that particular area. This also extends to knowledge of local flora and fauna.
